answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system through a prism of node ratings, where each agent is assigned an onyx identifier tied to its unique cryptographic key. When an agent proposes a transaction, it must first bridge a proof-of-work challenge, which requires significant computational resources. An attacker attempting to create multiple Sybil identities would need to expend substantial energy to bridge multiple challenges, making it economically infeasible to launch a successful attack.
